name: OnlyFriends Stories: Special Agent Wexler
source:
The story focuses on Special Agent Wexler (Valerie from the main game OnlyFriends) who was sent on a mission to the Abbey Road Federal Prison. And she is ready to do anything to complete this task, because we are talking about saving dozens of lives!

This addition is not connected in any way with the original "OnlyFriends" storyline.
